architecture_delta_fusion.existing_f2_adoption_direction: Full telemetry/data spine is currently REIMPLEMENT; external observability may be an independent witness/donor, not a second authority.

observed_architecture: local-first agent observability CLI plus reusable Rust capture/analysis crates
Linux eBPF boundary tracing for process/file/network/system effects
userspace TLS plaintext capture via SSL/BoringSSL/OpenSSL probe attachment when supported
process-lineage plus temporal-proximity plus argument-matching correlation
saved SQLite sessions, JSON/report surfaces, OTLP GenAI export, web views
fallback to native agent session files/process snapshots when eBPF is unavailable
requirements_and_weight: full eBPF record/debug path is Linux-specific and requires root/sudo or relevant BPF/admin capabilities
README recommends kernel 5.0+ though 4.1+ eBPF support is stated
Docker eBPF mode requires privileged host access
Rust collector package version 1.0.30 declares rust-version 1.87 and a nontrivial dependency set including Tokio, Rusqlite, Hyper, Rustls, Ratatui and sibling AgentSight crates
captured DB/log data can contain prompts, responses, headers, file paths and network targets; treat as sensitive
real_failure_modes: static/stripped TLS implementations require binary discovery or pattern matching and may break across versions
Electron IDE agents do not obtain full eBPF/TLS capture; AgentSight falls back to native session ingestion
protobuf/non-JSON traffic can be captured at transport level but still fail LLM semantic event extraction
privilege and kernel requirements can prevent full sidecar capture
secondary-LLM semantic analysis is inference, not canonical causal truth
temporal proximity and argument matching are heuristic correlation signals and can misattribute concurrent effects

integration_assessment.authority_fence: AgentSight observations may witness candidate effects and resource use, but EntityOS/F2 canonical state and EffectGate/EffectJournal execution-verification authority remain separate. An AgentSight event never mints effect success.

counterhypotheses.text: F2-native telemetry already captures enough causal/resource evidence; AgentSight adds little independent information and only duplicates data.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Equivalent A/B F2 workload shows AgentSight uniquely detects at least one true child/process/file/network effect or root-cause signal missing from F2-native telemetry with acceptable overhead.

counterhypotheses.text: Privilege/TLS attachment fragility makes AgentSight unreliable on the actual F2 target environment.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Pinned target-environment canary captures deterministic process lineage plus selected effect classes across repeated runs without manual binary surgery and reports explicit coverage gaps.

counterhypotheses.text: Correlation heuristics create false causal edges under concurrent GRID/child execution.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Overlapping A/B child workload with ground-truth invocation IDs yields acceptably low false attribution and preserves UNKNOWN for ambiguous effects.

counterhypotheses.text: A thinner F2-native eBPF/process observer is lower-risk than importing AgentSight.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: A bounded AgentSight sidecar materially outperforms the thin observer on coverage/maintenance/time-to-evidence without violating authority or privacy fences.
